Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration

While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations.   • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.

Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

At-Will Employment

Employment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

description:
Über uns: Die Baubranche ist einer der größten Wirtschaftszweige der Welt – und einer der am wenigsten digitalisierten. Wir bei Cosuno ändern das. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden ConTech-Scale-ups Europas revolutionieren wir den Einkauf und die Nachunternehmervergabe. Wir haben ein starkes Produkt, exzellente Metriken und ambitionierte Wachstumsziele. Um unsere kommerzielle Skalierung auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir eine herausragende Persönlichkeit, die direkt mit unserem Gründerteam und dem CRO zusammenarbeitet.

Deine Mission: Als Chief of Staff (Commercial Focus) bist du kein reiner Berater, sondern ein "Builder". Du fungierst als rechte Hand des C-Levels, löst unsere komplexesten Wachstumsherausforderungen und treibst strategische Initiativen von der ersten Hypothese bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung voran.

  • Strategic Execution: Du übernimmst die Ownership für geschäftskritische Go-to-Market-Projekte über die Bereiche Enterprise Sales, Revenue Operations und Customer Success hinweg.

  • Commercial Excellence: Du identifizierst Ineffizienzen in unseren Funnels, entwickelst datengetriebene Lösungsansätze und skalierst unseren Umsatzmotor (Pricing-Strategien, neue Marktsegmente, Sales-Zyklen-Optimierung).

  • Cross-functional Leadership: Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen den Commercial-Teams und Product/Tech, brichst Silos auf und sorgst dafür, dass alle an einem Strang ziehen, um unsere OKRs zu übertreffen.

  • Executive Leverage: Du entlastest das Gründerteam und den CRO im operativen Tagesgeschäft, bereitest Board-Meetings vor und triffst eigenständig Vorabentscheidungen auf C-Level-Niveau.


Dein Profil: Wir suchen einen analytischen Vordenker mit einer absoluten "Get-shit-done"-Mentalität. Du kannst auf Flughöhe strategisch diskutieren, scheust dich aber nicht davor, tief in die Daten oder operativen Prozesse abzutauchen.
Top-Tier Erfahrung: Du bringst 2-3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung aus einer führenden Strategieberatung mit. Alternativ hast du bereits in einer ähnlich exponierten, strategischen Rolle in einem High-Growth B2B-SaaS-Umfeld massiven Impact bewiesen.
Commercial Acumen: Du hast eine starke Affinität zu B2B-Software-Metriken (ARR, CAC, LTV, Churn) und idealerweise bereits Projekte in den Bereichen GTM-Strategie, Sales Excellence oder Pricing begleitet.
Analytische Exzellenz: Du triffst Entscheidungen nicht aus dem Bauch heraus, sondern basierend auf Daten. Du beherrschst Financial/Commercial Modeling und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte in klare Handlungsempfehlungen übersetzen.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst präzise, auf den Punkt und kannst auf C-Level sowie im Board-Kontext souverän agieren.
Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Muttersprachenniveau) und exzellente Englischkenntnisse.

Warum Cosuno?
Massiver Impact & Sichtbarkeit: Deine Arbeit hat direkten, messbaren Einfluss auf den Erfolg und die Bewertung unseres Unternehmens.
Fast-Track Karriere: Die CoS-Rolle ist als Sprungbrett konzipiert. Beweist du dich hier, stehen dir langfristig Türen für Senior-Leadership-Rollen (z.B. VP, Head of) innerhalb von Cosuno offen.
Flexibilität & Kultur: Arbeite aus unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain oder nutze unser hybrides Modell. Wir pflegen eine Kultur der absoluten Transparenz, wenig Politik und schnellen Entscheidungen.
Das Setup: Ein unbefristeter Vertrag, State-of-the-art Equipment, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein extrem motiviertes, internationales Team, das gemeinsam gewinnen will.

Compensation: €90K – €120K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

  • • Base salary €90K – €120K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Commercial Operations Specialist
description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK's Search Data & Quality team works to ensure that the travel results seen by millions of users every day are accurate, complete, and trustworthy. As a Commercial Operations Specialist, you will take ownership of a dedicated area of accuracy operations - operating monitoring processes, investigating issues, identifying root causes, and working with colleagues across Engineering, Performance Marketing, and Commercial to make sure problems are resolved and processes are well-documented for the long term.

This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Maintain and operate recurring monitoring processes to track accuracy across hotel search results, identifying issues proactively before they affect users or partners

  • Investigate accuracy issues - such as price discrepancies, availability mismatches, and linking errors - categorise root causes, and coordinate with internal teams to drive resolution

  • Define and document clear escalation paths, ensuring the right teams are engaged at the right time and that recurring issues are tracked through to a fix

  • Build and maintain documentation so that coverage and backup are always in place

  • Monitor key performance indicators to identify risks and opportunities, and propose practical solutions

  • Coordinate with Engineering, Performance Marketing, and Commercial colleagues; translate findings into clear, actionable requests

  • Contribute to broader data quality initiatives as the scope of the role evolves over time

  • Share knowledge with teammates and support the team's learning on accuracy operations, tools, and processes

Please apply if you have:

  • 1-3 years of experience working in operations, analytics, or a related role, with demonstrated impact on product or business outcomes; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are equally considered

  • A methodical, investigative approach to problem-solving - comfortable digging into data to find root causes and propose solutions

  • Comfort working with data - for example, using SQL or a comparable tool - and the ability to turn findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical colleagues

  • Experience contributing to multiple projects simultaneously and making informed decisions about priorities

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to prepare concise documentation and present findings to colleagues and leadership

  • A collaborative approach and enjoyment of building working relationships across engineering, commercial, and marketing teams

  • Attention to detail and a genuine care for data accuracy and quality

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and a willingness to take ownership of your work

It would be a bonus if you also have:

  • Familiarity with the travel industry, online travel agencies, or hotel distribution

  • Experience with data visualization tools or log analysis platforms (these can also be developed on the job)

  • Curiosity about how large-scale search systems work and how data accuracy affects user experience.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

     

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

title: Account Executive Nordics
description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the role

Litmus is hiring an Account Executive to own and grow new business with industrial manufacturers across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland and Finland.

Litmus is an industrial DataOps and edge AI platform. We help manufacturers connect, normalize and use data from their plants, from shop-floor assets up to the cloud. Our customers use Litmus to break down OT data silos and scale analytics and AI across sites.

You will be the face of Litmus in the Nordics. You will build pipeline, run complex enterprise sales cycles end to end, and work closely with our pre-sales team, hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) and system integrators. You report to the EMEA sales lead.

What you will do

• Own a Nordic territory and its revenue target, from prospecting to signed contract and expansion.

• Build and qualify pipeline through outbound, events, partners and inbound leads.

• Run discovery with plant, operations, OT and IT stakeholders up to C-level, and map their business case for change.

• Lead structured, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value, commercial proposals and negotiation.

• Work hand in hand with pre-sales on demos, solution design and technical validation.

• Co-sell with hyperscalers and system integrators, and develop partner-sourced opportunities in your region.

• Keep forecasts and opportunity data accurate in Salesforce.

• Expand existing accounts from first site to multi-site and global rollouts.

• Bring market feedback back to product, marketing and leadership.

What you bring

Segment experience (required)

• 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven record of meeting or beating quota.

• Direct sales experience in industrial software: IIoT, industrial DataOps, data historians, MES, SCADA, edge computing or manufacturing analytics.

• A solid grasp of the OT/IT landscape in manufacturing, and of how plant data flows from machines to the cloud.

• Experience selling into manufacturing, process industries, energy or similar industrial sectors.

Nordic market knowledge (required)

• An established network among industrial manufacturers in the Nordics.

• A working understanding of Nordic buying culture, decision-making and procurement.

• Familiarity with the regional partner and system integrator landscape.

• Fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or Finnish).

How you work

• Comfortable running long, complex deals with many stakeholders.

• Disciplined in qualification and forecasting (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or similar).

• Self-driven and at ease building a territory in a growing team.

Nice to have

• Experience selling alongside Microsoft, AWS, Google or Databricks.

• Track record of displacing incumbent industrial software, such as historians or legacy integration tools.

• Experience in an early-stage or scale-up team in a new region.

Travel and location

• Up to 40% travel within the Nordics and to EMEA team and partner events.

• Based in the Nordics, ideally near Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen or Helsinki.

title: Werkstudent Finance & Accounting (all genders)
description:
Willkommen bei Glow25!

Wir sind ein dynamisches, schnell wachsendes Beauty- & Pro-Aging-Unternehmen aus Berlin. Unsere Herzensmission: Glow-Momente, die bleiben – für unsere Community und für uns als Team.

Arbeit darf bei uns inspirieren, begeistern und Spaß machen. Dafür suchen wir smarte, empathische Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und mit uns wachsen.

Werde Teil von Glow25 und hilf uns, Schönheit neu zu definieren. Wir freuen uns auf dich!


Das sind unsere aktuellen Herausforderungen und Ziele:

Unser Finance-Team baut gerade aktiv seine Strukturen, Prozesse und digitale Infrastruktur auf. Als Werkstudent (all genders) bei Glow25 packst du mittendrin mit an: Du bringst dein Steuerfach-Wissen aus der Ausbildung direkt ein, übernimmst eigene Aufgaben im Accounting und Treasury und hilfst uns, unser Wissen strukturiert und digital verfügbar zu machen.

Wenn du strukturiert denkst, digitale Tools liebst und Lust hast, echte Prozesse mitzugestalten, dann freuen wir uns auf dich.


Hier brauchen wir deine Unterstützung:

  • Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Finance-Intranetseite in Notion und pflegst sie – Richtlinien, Prozessbeschreibungen und Wegweiser werden dort strukturiert gesammelt und aktuell gehalten.

  • Du unterstützt unser Accounting-Team bei steuerlichen Themen – hier kommt dir deine Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r direkt zugute.

  • Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben im Bereich Accounting und Treasury und wächst Schritt für Schritt in mehr Verantwortung hinein.

  • Du bereitest Daten und Unterlagen auf und unterstützt das Team bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben im Finance-Bereich.


Das bringst du mit:

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r und studierst aktuell BWL oder einen verwandten Studiengang.

  • Du bringst dadurch fundierte Praxiserfahrung in Buchhaltung und steuerlichen Themen mit.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Tools – Notion, Excel & Co. machen dir Spaß, kein Frust (Must-have).

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C1) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.


Das sind Charakterzüge, die dich beschreiben:

  • Du denkst strukturiert und hast Freude daran, Ordnung in Informationen zu bringen.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und bringst Eigeninitiative mit.

  • Du bist neugierig und lernbereit – neue Themen gehst du proaktiv an.

  • Du bist ein echter Teamplayer und arbeitest gerne mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen.


Darauf kannst du dich freuen:

  • Flexibel arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt. Arbeite wann und wo du am produktivsten bist - mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und smarter Stundenerfassung.

  • Top ausgestattet, von Tag eins. Mac oder Windows - du entscheidest selbst, womit du am liebsten arbeitest.

  • Glow Card – dein monatliches Extra. Jeden Monat 50 € Guthaben: Einfach shoppen, genießen, freuen - das sind 600 € im Jahr on top.

  • Lernen gehört bei uns einfach dazu. Ob Glowcademy, Lernzeit oder persönliche Förderung - wir investieren in dich, nicht nur in Zahlen.

  • Let’s Glow! 40 % Rabatt auf unser komplettes Sortiment - yes, wirklich alles.

  • Auszeit? Gönn dir. 30 Tage Urlaub + 1 persönlicher Feiertag + bis zu 10 Tage unbezahlten Urlaub, wenn du mal wirklich abschalten willst. Silvester ist on top auch frei!

  • Gesund? Bleibt so. Mit unserer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung bekommst du bis zu 1000 € im Jahr für Extras wie Sehhilfen, Heilpraktiker oder Zahnreinigung zurück.

  • Für später ist auch gesorgt Nach der Probezeit gibt’s 600 € Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge - und wenn du selbst mit einzahlst, legen wir nochmal 20 % drauf.

  • Exklusive Vorteile nur für dich. Über unsere Corporate-Benefits-Plattformen sicherst du dir Rabatte und Goodies bei starken Partnern.

  • Teamspirit to go. Unser Glow25 Merch ist mehr als nur Stoff - er zeigt, dass du Teil von etwas Besonderem bist.

  • Kultur, die wirklich strahlt. Seit fünf Jahren in Folge sind wir als Top Company bei Kununu ausgezeichnet - ein echtes Zeichen für unsere starke, positive und gelebte Kultur.

  • Move your way. Vom Workout bis zur Wellness-Auszeit - du entscheidest, wie du dich fit hältst. Mit Urban Sports Club oder Wellpass hast du die Wahl.

 

Yay! Du hast es bis hierher geschafft!

Wenn du jetzt immer noch liest, ist die Wahrscheinlichkeit groß, dass wir ein Match sind.

Eine Sache liegt uns aber noch auf dem Herzen:
Trau dich! Vor allem als Frau, oder als jemand einer unterrepräsentierten Bevölkerungsgruppe. Auch wenn du nicht überall einen Haken setzen kannst, möchten wir dich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wir glauben, dass eine bunte Vielfalt von Perspektiven und Erfahrungen ein Team stärker macht - und je stärker unser Team ist, desto besser erreichen wir unsere Mission, Menschen zu mehr Energie im Alltag zu verhelfen.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Plane

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

 

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

title: (Senior) Product Engineer (f/m/x)
description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

About Enpal's Innovation Subsidiary

At Enpal's Innovation Subsidiary Omniwatt, we're building the future of smart energy for European households. Our vision is a Europe where every household manages its energy intelligently and everyone benefits.

Our mission is to bring innovative energy products directly to consumers, including smart meters, electricity tariffs, and Virtual Power Plant (VPP) solutions.

As part of our Commercial Team, we're building our B2C growth engine from the ground up. We're launching new customer acquisition channels, experimenting with new products, and continuously working towards product-market fit.

We are looking for a Product Engineer who works at the intersection of product, engineering, and growth. In this role, you will develop and launch digital products, build and test MVPs, and implement technical solutions that improve customer acquisition.

What you’ll do

1. Build & Launch Digital Products

  • Build customer-facing applications, landing pages and conversion funnels to support B2C growth.

  • Rapidly develop, launch, and iterate on MVPs to test hypotheses and validate new product ideas.

  • Design and run data-driven experiments to measure performance and continuously improve customer acquisition.

2. Drive Product & Growth

  • Work closely with C-Level Members and the Commercial Team to identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and increase conversion rates.

  • Translate commercial needs into product requirements and prioritize initiatives based on business impact.

  • Leverage AI-powered tools and develop custom solutions to automate workflows and improve commercial performance.

3. Work close with both, the Engineering & Commercial Team

  • Collaborate with central engineering teams on API integrations, customer handovers, and data consistency across systems.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of technical initiatives, proactively managing dependencies and balancing speed with quality and scalability.

  • Act as the technical interface between Commercial and Engineering, aligning business requirements with technical implementation.

What you’ll bring

  • Educational background: An excellent academic track record, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related quantitative field.

  • Relevant experience: Initial professional experience in software engineering, product development, technical product management, or as a startup founder, ideally in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment.

  • Hands-on engineering skills: Strong proficiency in modern web technologies such as JavaScript, React/Next.js, and HTML/CSS. Experience with tools such as Vercel, Supabase, and PostHog or comparable alternatives.

  • Will to win: A strong drive to achieve ambitious goals, take ownership, and consistently deliver results, even with limited resources. You set high standards, move fast, and proactively overcome challenges.

  • Builder mindset: A proven track record of independently developing and shipping products, tools, or automations that have created measurable business impact.

  • Analytical approach: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-informed decisions and measure the impact of your work.

  • Languages: Full professional proficiency in German and English.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Build from zero: Play a key role in building Omniwatt's digital growth engine and launching new smart energy products.

  • End-to-end ownership: Own the full product lifecycle, from identifying an opportunity to shipping a solution and measuring its commercial impact.

  • Speed & experimentation: Operate in an entrepreneurial environment where rapid prototyping, testing, and learning are part of everyday work.

title: Freelance Senior AI Platform Expert - Azure Databricks
description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

We are looking for an experienced freelancer to advise and support our internal platform team in designing, building and improving an AI platform on Azure Databricks. The role is internal only, with no client-facing responsibilities.

The freelancer will act as a senior technical reference for the team, helping shape the architecture, establish engineering standards, review technical implementations and support the team in building and operating a reliable, scalable and secure platform. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on technical expertise with the ability to mentor engineers and transfer knowledge.

The freelancer will support the team across the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the platform, including:

  • Defining and reviewing the target architecture on Azure Databricks, covering workspaces, environments (dev/test/prod), Unity Catalog, security, networking and integration with Azure services.

As CRM Manager – Lifecycle & Engagement (f/m/d) at 7NXT Health Group, you design and optimise end-to-end lifecycle experiences across our brands and markets. You build habit-forming journeys that convert, engage and retain users at scale — combining behavioural science, data-driven experimentation and high-quality communication across Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit and Preneo. Nice-to-have

  • Experience applying behavioural science to lifecycle design

People who make things happen

7NXT Health Group is Europe’s leading platform group for digital fitness and mental wellbeing. Through our brands Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit and Preneo, we reach 20–30 million people per month across 9 European markets, helping them live healthier lives — physically and mentally. Our team of ~170 people grows organically, works at eye level, and genuinely practises what we preach.

We believe in trust over rigid structures, smart working over endless meetings — and that sustainability, inclusion and diversity aren’t buzzwords, they’re how we actually operate.

Everyone counts

We welcome what makes you unique.

At 7NXT Health Group we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here.

Don’t meet all the criteria? No problem — if you’d like to help shape the future of health & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application.

Need a more accessible process or have questions? Write to us — we’ll find a way.

title: (Senior) Data Engineer – Healthcare
description:
About PAICON

PAICON is a Heidelberg-based health data intelligence company building the global health data foundation through its PaiX ecosystem, working to close the representation gap in medical data so personalised medicine works for everyone. We harmonise ethically approved, GDPR compliant real-world health data from providers around the world into a global dataset. The data covers multiple modalities on various disease entities. Our flagship product, PaiX Navigator, generates actionable insights for pharma, biotech and AI companies worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to integrate data from our global partners into our platform. Data integration is the core of the role, and agentic AI tooling is part of how we do it. This is an on-site position in our Heidelberg office.

You will work closely with medical, engineering and commercialization colleagues in a small, pragmatic team with short decision paths and direct access to the founders.

What you'll do

  • Onboard new data partners, from first assessment of their data through to reliable production ingestion

  • Map partner data to our internal data model and work with providers to close gaps

  • Build and maintain robust, well-tested data pipelines

  • Ensure high standards in data quality and help evolve our database and data infrastructure

  • Document data and transformations so that every step is transparent and traceable

  • Ensure data is handled securely, de-identified and in line with healthcare data regulations

  • Help us apply AI-assisted methods to data integration, with appropriate quality checks

What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on data engineering, including building and running production data pipelines

  • Strong SQL and relational database design skills

  • R and Python skills on Linux systems

  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7 FHIR and common clinical coding systems

  • Understanding of data privacy and security in a regulated environment, including GDPR

  • Day-to-day use of AI-assisted development tools and curiosity to go further with them

  • A pragmatic mindset: you choose the simplest solution that works

  • Ability to turn messy, real-world data into clear findings and next steps

  • Good communication with technical and non-technical colleagues

  • Independent, hands-on working style with agile mindset

  • Fluent English, our primary working language

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with genomics/clinical & pathology data/digital histopathology data

  • Experience with graph databases or ontologies

  • Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure on hyperscalers.

What you get from joining PAICON

  • Hybrid working, with core office days to help organise how you do your best work

  • An inclusive team where different backgrounds and perspectives are part of the point

  • A friendly, motivated and agile environment where things move quickly and you see the impact of your work

  • Flat hierarchies and short decision paths, with direct access to founders and medical, engineering and commercial colleagues

  • Real ownership of your ideas: propose something good and you will be the one building it

You will join a team solving a problem that matters, in a company where your voice carries weight from day one. There are no long approval chains between a good idea and a production system, and no layers between you and the people who depend on the data you integrate. If you want to shape how global health data is built rather than inherit someone else’s architecture, this is the place to do it! Cheers!

title: Controller für Infrastruktur- & Ingenieurprojekte (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind ein wachsendes Infrastruktur- und Ingenieurunternehmen mit Fokus auf zukunftsfähige Projekte in den Bereichen Straßenbau, Brücken, Tunnel, Altlasten sowie Wasser- und Versorgungsinfrastruktur.

Wir verbinden technische Expertise mit unternehmerischem Denken und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Für unseren weiteren Wachstumskurs suchen wir einen Controller (m/w/d), der unser Controlling aktiv mit aufbaut, unsere Gesellschaften operativ unterstützt und Transparenz für fundierte unternehmerische Entscheidungen schafft.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projekt- und Unternehmenscontrolling: Du baust unser Controlling auf Gruppen- und Gesellschaftsebene auf und entwickelst es kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei begleitest du unsere einzelnen Gesellschaften aktiv bei der Einführung geeigneter Controllingstrukturen und -prozesse.
  • Hands-on-Unterstützung der Gesellschaften: Du arbeitest eng mit den operativen Teams zusammen, hilfst bei konkreten Fragestellungen und befähigst sie wirtschaftliche Kennzahlen und Zusammenhänge eigenständig zu verstehen und zu steuern.

  • Digitalisierung und KI: Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Reporting- und Controllingprozesse voran und prüfst, wie digitale Lösungen, Automatisierung und künstliche Intelligenz unsere Arbeit effizienter und besser machen können.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Bauingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes Verständnis wirtschaftlicher Zusammenhänge.

  • Interesse an Infrastruktur- und Ingenieurprojekten sowie an digitalen Lösungen und KI.
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern, Geschäftsführungen, Ingenieuren, Projektteams sowie Investoren und Banken zusammen.

Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

The Opportunity

The SandboxAQ AI team is looking for a hands-on Manager, AI Engineering to help us build the future of agentic collaboration, trust and ROI. Our goal is to make agents work well on their own, in teams, and with humans. This includes the following aspects:

  • Security: Discovery of agents, evaluation, red teaming, monitoring, guardrails, etc.

  • Quality: Measuring ROI of agents and suggesting improvements

  • Collaboration: Bringing humans and agents together into one place with shared context

A successful candidate thrives at the intersection of AI and software engineering. You deeply understand how models and agents work, how they can fail, how they can be protected and improved. You have hands-on experience with agents in production, know what works and what doesn’t, know the latest trends and you’re opinionated about the future. You know what you don’t know and enjoy learning to close those gaps. You’ll turn your insights and innovation into real world features baked into our platform - shipping code to production.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll break things, fix them and then harden them for good while also leading a small team of engineers. At the same time, you’ll have freedom to explore, collaborate, publish, and deploy, shaping the field of agentic collaboration and trust from all angles. You will help set technical direction, raise the quality bar, mentor team members, and ensure that the team moves quickly from research insight to real-world product impact.

We’re looking for somebody with the curiosity of a researcher, the rigor of an engineer, and the creativity of a hacker. You will be part of a diverse team consisting of ML experts, security experts, mathematicians, and software engineers, each playing a key role in efficient and effective enablement of the cutting-edge technologies being developed at SandboxAQ.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a small, highly technical team while remaining deeply involved in hands-on engineering and research.

  • Set technical direction, break down ambiguous problems, establish practical plans for fast, high-quality execution, and build a culture of ownership, low-ego collaboration, thoughtful experimentation, and high standards.

  • Create new agentic capabilities, including frameworks for monitoring, guardrailing, and evaluating agents, while staying current on the latest agentic developments and identifying new opportunities.

  • Perform classical ML tasks, including exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model fine-tuning, and rapidly iterate on prototypes and features based on feedback and evolving product needs.

  • Work closely with Product and Research to translate AI research into applicable features and software engineering projects.

  • Contribute production-ready code and technical designs, working across engineering to deliver scalable, reliable software.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • BSc in Computer Science or related field with exposure to AI/ML.

  • Deep expertise in AI/ML, software engineering, or AI security.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, and relevant ML and/or agentic frameworks.

  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with a high degree of end-to-end ownership, delivering real world outcomes.

  • Ability to pick up other programming languages and technologies as required to ship scalable and reliable software.

Highly Desired Skills & Experience

  • PhD in Computer Science or related field with focus on AI/ML or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: agent orchestration, agent harnesses, agent teams, jailbreaking / prompt injection, red teaming, data poisoning or evasion attacks, secure model deployment or sandboxing, detection and monitoring for AI misuse.

  • Experience contributing to open source projects.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Experience in cybersecurity is a plus, but not essential.

Why Join Us?

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work.

  • Career Defining Work: Your work will directly accelerate the discovery of better drugs and better materials, advance human health, and enable safer and more sustainable technologies by helping customers put AI Simulation capabilities into real world use.

  • Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

  • Work-Life Balance: Fully remote, Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.

  • Learning and Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.

SandboxAQ Welcomes All

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are currently seeking an exceptional Senior Strategic Finance Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team. You can be based in either our Barcelona or London office.

The Strategic Finance department is responsible for crafting our long-term strategic roadmap and optimizing how we allocate resources to fuel our growth and create lasting value. Reporting to the Senior Director of Strategic Finance, you will be pivotal in shaping the company's operational plan and creating scalable business models. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll be instrumental in translating intricate operational goals into financial outcomes. Your keen analytical skills and effective communication abilities will be put to good use as you cultivate strong relationships throughout the organization. We aim to build a top-tier strategic finance team that prioritizes unwavering accountability. If you're ready to embark on this journey with us, read on!

 

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of both short-term and long-term forecasting models, ensuring the leadership team has the data for precise decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with key cross-functional teams, in particular the go-to-market team, to gain insights into critical business developments that could impact future projections.

  • Support for the comprehensive planning and execution of both the long-term strategic plan and the annual operating plan.

  • Utilize an analytical approach to influence strategic decision-making, encompassing capital allocation and long-term financial planning choices.

  • Execute essential financial processes, including reporting, forecasting, budgeting, ROI-based resource allocation, and internal as well as external benchmarking.

  • Monitor crucial performance metrics and offer valuable insights through regular reporting and ad hoc analysis.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous experience in investment banking, management consulting, or strategic finance/FP&A. Expertise or coverage of go-to-market functions within any of these roles is a bonus but not a must.

  • A track record of exceptional performance in demanding, high-calibre teams.

  • Data-driven mindset, a bias for rapid decision-making, favouring excellence over perfection.

  • Proficiency in Excel, including the ability to create and manage complex financial models.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in analytical work - accelerating analysis, stress-testing assumptions, automating repetitive processes - and the judgment to know when human input is still essential.

  • Strong knowledge of financial statements, accounting principles, and investment analysis.

  • Capability to comprehend and collaborate with various lines of business.

  • Willingness to stretch beyond your comfort zone and embrace new challenges.

  • Openness to feedback, with a commitment to continuous improvement, development, and innovation.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a quantitative field.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

What you'll do

  • Generate some of your own pipeline alongside SDR support, prospecting into a clearly defined ideal customer profile.

  • Run structured discovery calls solo, identifying pain and priorities for your primary buyer.

  • Close mid-market deals with negotiation support from the CRO as you build experience with more complex procurement.

  • Maintain your own weekly pipeline and forecast, developing commit accuracy over time.

  • Work SDR and Customer Success handoffs as directed, keeping CRM records clean and up to date.


What you'll bring

  • 3–5 years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, or a strong track record in an adjacent commercial role (for example SDR) ready to step up.

  • A track record at or near 100% of quota (around £500k–£750k) in at least one of the last two years.

  • Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them.

  • Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked.

  • Genuinely bright and inquisitive: good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured.

  • Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance.

  • Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory.

What you'll get

  • Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off

  • Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team.

  • A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme.

  • Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover.

  • More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme.

  • Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
